analysis.overview: The frames preserve extensive baseline campus guidance while adding construction-specific entrance, hours, accessibility, staffing, and communication changes. Most differences are explicitly construction-scoped; however, the compared card-only instruction conflicts with the baseline option to use either a card or registered app after hours.
